name: saas-file-manager
context: Design a file browser and manager interface for a SaaS application. The audience is users organizing, uploading, and managing documents and media files. Target platforms: desktop (primary) and tablet. Must support grid and list view toggle, breadcrumb navigation, file actions (rename, move, delete), and drag-and-drop upload.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json for file names, metadata, and path breadcrumbs
Apply color.rules.json for file type indicators and selection highlights
Use layout.rules.json grid for file grid view and table for list view
File items must use proper listbox or grid semantics for keyboard navigation
Drag-and-drop upload must provide aria-live upload progress feedback
Multi-select must support Shift+Click and Ctrl+Click patterns

outputCriteria.format: Component composition spec with dual view modes, interaction states, and upload flow
qualityChecks: All color values resolve to semantic tokens
Grid and list views use consistent spacing from Token_System
File type icons use semantic color mapping
Upload progress documents all states (idle, uploading, success, error)
accessibilityRequirements: File list uses grid or listbox role with arrow key navigation
Selection state announced to screen readers
Breadcrumb navigation uses nav landmark with aria-label
Upload progress announced via aria-live polite
Context menu actions available via keyboard shortcut

examples.description: File grid item with thumbnail and metadata
examples.output:
Molecule: FileGridItem
  Layout: flex(direction: column, gap: var(--space-xs))
  bg: var(--color-surface-primary)
  border: var(--border-default)
  radius: var(--radius-md)
  padding: var(--space-sm)
  role: gridcell
  Children:
    - Atom: FileThumbnail(height: 120px, radius=var(--radius-sm), bg=var(--color-surface-secondary))
    - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.sm, color=color.text.primary, truncate=true)
    - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.xs, color=color.text.tertiary, content='file-size + date')
  States: default, hover(shadow: var(--shadow-sm)), selected(border-color: var(--color-primary), bg: var(--color-surface-selected)), focus(outline: var(--color-focus-ring))
acceptanceCriteria: Uses semantic tokens for all styling
Focus ring visible on keyboard navigation
